llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed read-only VMware log search integration with expected handling of Log Insight credentials and audit records.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads centralized infrastructure logs and alert metadata, which can contain sensitive operational details, but that access is necessary for its troubleshooting purpose and is bounded by documented query windows and limits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a standard uv tool package plus documented config files under ~/.vmware-log-insight; the inspected artifact contains no hidden executable installer scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to explicit VMware/vSphere/ESXi Log Insight workflows, with routing away from vCenter alarms, performance metrics, and unrelated log sources.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses persistent MCP call auditing in ~/.vmware/audit.db and local password storage in ~/.vmware-log-insight/.env with chmod 600 and b64 obfuscation; these are purpose-aligned but should be handled as sensitive local data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is VMware Aria Operations for Logs search, aggregation, metadata, and alert-history lookup; the artifact consistently describes seven read-only tools and no ingest, edit, delete, or alert-management capability.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use a least-privilege read-only Log Insight account, protect the .env file, prefer a real secret manager over b64-obfuscated stored passwords, and treat ~/.vmware/audit.db as sensitive because it may preserve operational query metadata.
llm.findings: [RA2] expected: The audit database concern is supported by the artifact, but it is clearly disclosed as operational audit logging for read-only MCP calls rather than hidden persistence, background execution, or unrelated data collection.
